# WantPrompt

> WantPrompt is a free library of 100 hand-crafted AI prompts for writing, marketing, business, coding, image generation, productivity, learning, and fun. Every prompt has fill-in-the-blank fields, a copy button, and a built-in free AI that runs it in the browser — no signup, no API key, no browser extension, no paywall. Agent Mode drafts, critiques, and polishes output in three steps.

## Why only 100 prompts?

Most prompt libraries are unfiltered community dumps — thousands of prompts where reviewers found only a small fraction genuinely useful, and users burn hours sorting the good from the generic. WantPrompt is the opposite bet: 100 prompts, each written by hand for a specific job, each with fill-in variables so the output fits your situation. Curation is the feature.

## How to use a prompt

1. Pick a prompt from the library at https://wantprompt.com/
2. Fill in the [BRACKETED] variables with your details
3. Copy it into ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or any AI chat tool — the prompts are model-neutral, not tied to one chatbot
4. Or run it on the site with the built-in free AI, no signup. Agent Mode (draft → critique → polish) is for prompts where the first answer is rarely good enough

## What makes a good prompt (the formula behind every prompt here)

Role + task + constraints + format. Name who the AI should act as, say exactly what to produce, set the limits (tone, length, audience), and specify the output format. A prompt missing any of the four produces a generic answer.

## Library by category (100 prompts)

- Writing (13): blog outlines, cover letters, speeches, headlines, story plots
- Marketing (13): ad copy variations, launch teasers, influencer outreach, discount offers
- Business (12): performance reviews, partnership pitches, SWOT analysis
- Coding (12): test case generation, database schemas, error message decoding
- Images (13): book covers, interior design, food photography, album art
- Productivity (12): email declutter plans, morning routines, priority resets
- Learning (13): history timelines, science explainers, exam quizzes, flashcards
- Fun (12): bucket lists, compliments, would-you-rather games

## FAQ (short version)

- Is it free? Yes — all 100 prompts free, built-in AI free, no trial, no payment.
- Do I need an account or API key? No. Open the site, pick a prompt, run it.
- Do prompts work with Claude and Gemini, or just ChatGPT? They are model-neutral and work in any AI chat tool.
- Why is the built-in AI sometimes slow? It is a free shared service; the site retries automatically, and any prompt can be copied into another AI tool instead.
- Can I suggest a prompt or report one that doesn't work? Yes — hello@wantprompt.com.
